policyName: InfraPilot Enterprise Quality and Security Gate Policy

examples: Hardcoded AWS access key or secret
CVE with CVSS score 9.0+ in runtime dependencies or base image
Public S3 bucket with unauthenticated write access
Overly open security group (0.0.0.0/0 on port 22 or 3000)
HIGH CVE with available vendor fix in base container image
Missing IMDSv2 requirement on EC2 instances
Medium CVE without known exploit vectors
Missing automated volume snapshot retention tags
Minor code smells or missing Javadoc comments
